name: Interstate State Park, North Campground
waterfront_evidence: Split 2026-11-17, this entry = the North campground (sites 1-40). Esri World_Imagery read 2026-11-17 at 45.4040,-92.6482 (300 m half-width) and 45.4038,-92.6485 (160 m), plus Esri Wayback 2016-04-13 leaf-off (release 9598, z18) at 45.4037,-92.6482, all rendered: the loop (OSM service ways ~45.4030-45.4044, -92.6470..-92.6484) sits in woods north of the US 8 bridge; the St. Croix's east bank runs ~40-55 m west of the loop's west road (the 30-36 side) at 45.4033-45.4045 with a continuous wooded strip between (summer canopy; the leaf-off frame shows a treed bank, no open ground); the 23-25 spur north runs ~150 m from the water. No site on open ground within ~50 m of the river -> not riverfront; a filtered summer view from the west-side sites is not confirmed by any official site photo (GoingToCamp refuses automated reads) -> not waterfront by default-down. Lake O' the Dalles is ~1 km south past US 8. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: WI DNR Interstate camping page (https://dnr.wisconsin.gov/topic/parks/interstate/recreation/camping, read 2026-11-17): two campgrounds; 'The north campground is open May 1 through Oct. 31'; 'Shower facilities are available in the north campground for registered campers'. DNR North campground map (https://widnr.widen.net/s/smhxtqhncp/interstate_north-campground-map, read 2026-11-17): a drive-in loop off the park road with sites 1-40 less 10, 21 and 22 (37 sites, 27 marked E, 24 and 25 walk-to). The GoingToCamp fee panel read 2026-10-10 listed 54 RV-capable sites park-wide. A real state-park drive-in RV campground; it sits ~2 km (site-area centroids) from the South campground on its own road.
note: Wisconsin's oldest state park, on the Dalles of the St. Croix opposite Taylors Falls, MN. This is its electric campground, in woods beside the river just north of the US 8 bridge, on its own road off the park road. The rustic South campground, about 2 km away along Dalles Creek, has its own entry. --Claude

sites.note: 27 electric (1-9, 12-14, 16-20, 26-29, 31-36) and 10 without; 24 and 25 are walk-to. Site 32 is accessible.

facilities.note: The park's dump station is across the road from the Ice Age Interpretive Center, outside the campground.

fees.note: Park-wide range before any nonresident surcharge, covering the RV-capable sites of both campgrounds (54 sites, 2 fee schedules), Tuesday nights 2027-05-11 and 2027-06-15, from the wisconsin.goingtocamp.com site fee panel; not split by campground.

sites.source: https://widnr.widen.net/s/smhxtqhncp/interstate_north-campground-map (PDF via the Widen preview: sites 1-40 with no 10, 21 or 22; E on 1-9, 12-14, 16-20, 26-29, 31-36; walk-to symbol on 24 and 25; accessible symbol on 32E), read 2026-11-17

facilities.source: https://widnr.widen.net/s/smhxtqhncp/interstate_north-campground-map legend and symbols (Shower Building, Flush Toilets, Vault Toilets, Drinking Water in the loop) + https://dnr.wisconsin.gov/topic/parks/interstate/recreation/camping ('Shower facilities are available in the north campground for registered campers. There is a dump station across the road from the Ice Age Center.'), read 2026-11-17

season.source: https://dnr.wisconsin.gov/topic/parks/interstate/recreation/camping ('The north campground is open May 1 through Oct. 31.'), read 2026-11-17

curation_note: Split 2026-11-17: this id kept the North campground (sites 1-40, the electric one the pin already marked); the South campground (41-85, ~2 km SW on its own road) became a new entry. Sites 82 -> 37, season 05-01..11-14 -> 05-01..10-31 (the Nov 14 end was the South's RV season). Fees stay the 2026-10-10 park-wide GoingToCamp range, unsplit. Hookups unchanged (electric 50 rests on old note prose; amperage unverified, GoingToCamp refuses). --Claude
_reasons: Split: South campground (41-85) leaves - site-area centroids 2.02 km apart, nearest roads 1.77 km, each on its own spur road leaving the park road 1.17 km apart. 3291 keeps the North campground (the existing pin, the electric/shower campground); pin and elevation unchanged; waterfront re-checked on summer + 2016 leaf-off imagery (not waterfront, unchanged); sites 82 -> 37, facilities and season rewritten for North; fees kept as a labelled park-wide range; hookups and booking unchanged.
